headers.comment: frame-ancestors is 'self' only. It previously allowed vly.sh and freebuff.com so the managed-editor toolbar could be framed, but that editor is opt-in behind VITE_VLY_APP_ID and its bundle is now stripped from a normal build (see vite.config.ts). On the production origin those entries granted frame and network access to two third-party origins for a feature that cannot run here. A managed Vly deployment sets its own headers.
